Resolves #20041

Main now applies only the DOM updates of its own window.

A SharedWorker relays a worker-bound reply through any window of its app once the window the reply names has departed. That is the #19067 relay, kept so the flight cannot wedge. `Manager#onWorkerMessage` then applied the relayed vdom deltas to the relaying window's DOM. In `TearOutMatrixRows4To7NL` row 7 (the second AC-2 roving red on #20022), that deleted the pane main had just restored after a post-birth cancel. #20041 has the measurement.

The fix: a promise-less reply carrying `updateVdom` / `autoMount` deltas whose `windowId` names another window is not applied. Neither is an `updateVdom` whose `destination` names another window (#20026's class, at the sink). Both are answered with the rejection a departed port produces (`name: 'PortDisconnectedError'`, `code: 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'`), so the caller settles silently and adopts no vnode. The answer is a plain object because a cloned `Error` keeps only standard names. Replies without a `windowId` (dedicated workers) and replies naming this window keep today's path, and the relay in `worker.Base#sendMessage` is unchanged.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on a real SharedWorker app + unit child-process Manager) → L3 required (AC-2); L2 for AC-1, AC-3. AC-4 is the cut-record disposition.
